info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v3-spec
info.description: The Payments Void API allows businesses to reverse transactions and void payments that are no longer needed. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include payment processing systems, financial institutions, and e-commerce platforms that require the ability to manage payment states. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the process of handling payment cancellations, minimizing any associated billing complications.

delete.description: This operation allows you to void a payment that has been previously processed. Once successfully voided, the payment will no longer be active and any associated funds will be returned to the original payment method.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed to void a payment. It must contain all required fields that define the payment to be canceled.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: A request body for the DELETE operation on the payment void operation. This schema accepts a string value which can represent various content depending on the specific implementation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Payment Void Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the void operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time in milliseconds for the void operation.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the payment void operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the void operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the void operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the creation and automation of the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
